subject: Assessor request: PR approval matrix + ephemeral CI secrets audit
messages:
From: SecureAssess <audit@secureassess.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: ACME Security Ops <secops@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: artifacts for PR approval / secrets handling

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick intake earlier. ACME's assessor asked for a compact bundle covering our SDLC controls related to pull request approvals, CI/CD ephemeral secrets usage, and the recent change management activity for Q2. Specifically they requested:

- PR approval matrix (who can approve what, with dates and scope)
- The CI pipeline run export for the last successful deploy to prod (stdout/log excerpt is fine)
- Evidence of ephemeral secrets usage and scanning exceptions (any exception rationale + who approved it)
- A short chronological change log for the deployment (author, PR id, change reason)

Can you provide these artifacts by EOD PST today? If anything is restricted/can't be shared, flag it and explain what we can provide instead (redacted exports, attestation, or KMS audit proofs).

Also let us know the expected owners for each artifact (we'll list them in the report).

Best,
Eliot Moran
Senior Assessor, SecureAssess

---
NOTE: We may surface the files to ACME; redact any personal tokens or ephemeral keys in your attachments.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: SecureAssess <audit@secureassess.com>, ACME Security Ops <secops@acme.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: artifacts for PR approval / secrets handling

Eliot —

Thanks, we can provide the requested artifacts. I'm attaching a first-pass bundle to this thread (see attachments list). Owners:
- PR approval matrix: Marissa Cole (Platform eng)
- CI pipeline run export: Grace O'Connor (CI/Infra)
- Secrets scan exceptions: Irene Choi (Security)
- Change log summary: Ben Carter (Eng ops)

Two quick notes up-front:
1) Our secrets "exceptions" list contains a few entries that are hashed identifiers referencing ephemeral service tokens issued by Vault. We can provide the exception list with hashed IDs and the approval ticket, or a redacted JSON and a matching KMS rotation log if you need key custody proof.
2) The CI export is an obfuscated log (we scrubbed any full credential strings). If the assessor needs additional telemetry (run ids, worker IDs), we can hand those over under a limited-scope share.

Deliverables attached: pr_approval_matrix_v1.csv; ci_pipeline_run_20260601.log (scrubbed); secrets-scan-exceptions-20260601.json (hashed ids + approver notes); change_log_2026Q2.pdf

If that works, please confirm receipt. We can walk through live with ACME if they want a short demo of approval gates.

Thanks,
Ben
Director, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pr_approval_matrix_v1.csv (csv), ci_pipeline_run_20260601.log (text), secrets-scan-exceptions-20260601.json (json), change_log_2026Q2.pdf (pdf)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>

On Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700 Ben Carter wrote:
> Deliverables attached: pr_approval_matrix_v1.csv; ci_pipeline_run_20260601.log (scrubbed); secrets-scan-exceptions-20260601.json (hashed ids + approver notes); change_log_2026Q2.pdf

A couple of clarifications from Security before we hand this to the assessor:
- The secrets-scan-exceptions file includes one exception (ID: exc-7a3b) that was a justified bypass for an ephemeral service account used during a hotfix deploy. That exception still has open mitigation: rotation scheduled + postmortem. I recommend marking that record as "sensitive" and redacting the full justification text in any public-facing bundle; provide the ticket link instead (see JIRA-RED-4123).
- For the PR matrix, please ensure reviewer timestamps are included; ACME asked specifically for evidence that approvals were recorded prior to merge for a random sample (we should include three sample PRs and screenshots of the GitHub approval UI). Marissa — can you attach the three sample PR links + approval screenshots?

If assessor insists on full exception rationale we can provide it under an NDA addendum; otherwise the redacted record + rotation plan + ticket should suffice.

Irene
Sr Manager, Security Assurance

P.S. Grace — can you also verify that the CI run log we attached contains the run id (we need it for cross-correlation)?

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Summary and next steps after internal review: attached bundle (v1) includes the CSV approval matrix, the scrubbed CI export, the exceptions JSON with hashed ids, and the Q2 change log. Additional items we'll provide in follow-up (within 48 hours) if needed:

- Three sample PR links + approval UI screenshots (Marissa)
- KMS rotation audit excerpt for the ephemeral token referenced as exc-7a3b (Irene will provide under an access control statement)
